body.title: Privacy Policy
body.intro: This policy explains what information DotToDotFreePrintables.com collects when you visit, how it is used, and the choices you have. The short version: we do not require accounts, we do not sell personal information, and you can download every individual puzzle without giving us any personal data at all. An optional PDF bundle is available for purchase separately and uses a third-party payment processor for checkout.
body.analytics: Analytics. We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the site is used — pages visited, approximate location, device and browser type. Google Analytics sets cookies and collects identifiers for this purpose. This data is aggregated; we do not use it to identify individual visitors.
body.email: Email. If you email us, we receive your address and message. We use them only to reply and do not add you to any list.
body.forms: Forms and embeds. Some pages embed YouTube videos or Google Forms. If you interact with these, Google may process data under its own privacy policy.
body.notCollect: What we do not collect: no accounts, no passwords, no payment details, and no personal information is required to download or print any puzzle.
body.children: Our printables are made for children, but the website itself is directed at the adults who print them — parents, guardians, and teachers. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. The site has no accounts, comments, or chat. If you believe a child has sent us personal information by email, contact us and we will delete it.
body.ads: The site may display advertising to cover its costs. If advertising is active, ad providers may use cookies or similar technologies to show ads; where required, you will be asked for consent before any advertising cookies are set.
body.rights: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data, and to object to or restrict its processing. Because we hold almost no personal data, exercising these rights is usually as simple as emailing us. We do not sell or share personal information.
body.security: Analytics data is retained per Google Analytics default settings. Emails are kept only as long as needed to handle your message. The site is served over HTTPS.
body.changes: If this policy changes materially, the effective date above will be updated. Questions or requests: hellokidsbookworld@gmail.com or via the contact page.
